params.name: Input
params.description: The node whose surface is remeshed. Its triangles are rebuilt toward an even edge length; point attributes ride through splits and collapses.

params.name: Target Length
params.description: Edge length, in world units, the mesh is steered toward. Edges over 4/3 of it are split and edges under 4/5 collapsed; smaller means denser.

params.name: Iterations
params.description: How many times the split, collapse, flip and relax passes repeat. More rounds settle the mesh closer to the target; it stops early once nothing changes.

params.name: Relax
params.description: Strength of the tangential smoothing that slides points to even out triangles without moving the surface. 0 turns it off; 1 is full strength.

params.name: Split
params.description: Whether edges longer than 4/3 of the Target Length are split at their midpoint, adding points where the mesh is too coarse.

params.name: Collapse
params.description: Whether edges shorter than 4/5 of the Target Length are collapsed, removing points where the mesh is too dense. The surviving point keeps its values.

params.name: Flip
params.description: Whether edges are flipped to bring points closer to six neighbours each, which evens out the shape of the triangles.

params.name: Project
params.description: Whether relaxed points are pulled back onto the input surface after each round, so repeated remeshing does not shrink or drift the shape.

params.name: Transfer
params.description: After remeshing, copy point attributes (and optionally groups) onto the new points from the nearest point of a source mesh, so they survive the rebuild.

params.name: From
params.description: The node whose point attributes and groups are copied onto the remeshed points. Empty uses this node's own input as it was before the remesh.

params.name: Attributes
params.description: Comma-separated names of the point attributes to copy from the source. Empty copies every point attribute the source has.

params.name: Transfer Groups
params.description: Also copy point group membership from the nearest source point, joining and leaving groups to match the source.

params.name: Groups
params.description: Comma-separated names of the point groups to copy. Empty copies every point group the source has.

params.name: Maximum Distance
params.description: Only points within this many world units of a source point receive values; farther points keep their own. 0 means no limit.
